title: Tell Me Lies
synopsis: Eight years out of college. Your best friend is engaged to the man who ruined your twenties. The bachelorette weekend is in three weeks.

nodes.text: The bachelorette invite arrives by email. The names on the list include yours, and his sister's, and people you have not spoken to since graduation.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Reply yes” back. Friend shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.

nodes.text: Your therapist is, today, professionally curious. She asks whether you have ever, fully, told your best friend about him.

choices.consequence: “No” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
You commit to “Mostly.” The story records the instinct as “Half” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: The group chat is, against all instincts, friendly. People you stopped talking to in 2018 are, again, on a thread.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Engage.” The story records the instinct as “Friend” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Mute.” The story records the instinct as “Self” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: His sister, who never liked you, writes you a private DM. The DM is, surprisingly, kind.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Risk.
“Reply minimally” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Caution.

nodes.text: Your spouse is supportive in the way only a spouse can be. They also, gently, want to know what you actually want.

choices.consequence: “Tell them honestly” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Marriage.
There is no taking “Promise to figure it out” back. Process shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The plan is a winery weekend. The plan includes, at the explicit request of the bride, no boyfriends/husbands.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Commit to going” back. Friend shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
There is no taking “Hold off” back. Wait shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Your best friend calls. She has, she says, been afraid to ask you. She wants to know if you'll be okay.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Tell her yes” back. Cover shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

choices.text: Tell her you need to talk
choices.consequence: You commit to “Tell her you need to talk.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You meet for coffee. You decide whether to tell her everything you never told her about her fiancé.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
There is no taking “Tell her part” back. Half shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He emails you, unprompted. The email is, in a way you don't want to be true, charming.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Don't reply.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Closure—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You find your old college notebook. It is, in a real way, evidence. You read it.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Closure—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Keep it.” The story records the instinct as “Memory” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Two friends from the group chat — Pippa and Bree — invite you to dinner separately. They want, in different ways, to support you.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Allies.
There is no taking “Pick the safer one” back. Triage shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Pre-bachelorette drinks in the city. The bride is, you realize, happy. You decide what to do with that.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Be glad for her.” The story records the instinct as “Generous” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Watch for the signs.” The story records the instinct as “Cautious” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You arrive at the winery. He is not there. The weekend, briefly, is just women you love.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Present.
You commit to “Stay vigilant.” The story records the instinct as “Strategic” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Late on Friday night, the bride and you sit on a balcony and talk. You decide what to tell her now.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategic—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Saturday is a hike. You realize, on the trail, that the weekend is also a kind of healing for you.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Stay guarded” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Dinner. Toasts. People give speeches. You realize what kind of speech you'd give if asked.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Volunteer to speak.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Pippa, drunk, tells you what she always thought of him. You realize, with a strange relief, you weren't alone.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
You commit to “Just listen.” The story records the instinct as “Care” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Sunday morning. Coffee. Hangover. Bride beside you on the porch. You decide what kind of friend you're going to be for the next year.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.

nodes.text: The wedding date is in five months. You decide whether you'll be there.

choices.consequence: “Be there” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Friend.
There is no taking “Decline” back. Self shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He emails again. The email is, this time, an apology. You read it twice. You decide what it deserves.

choices.consequence: “Forgive privately” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Closure.
“Don't reply” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Discipline.

nodes.text: You come home Sunday night. Your spouse hugs you. You realize you have, finally, the family you wanted in college.

choices.text: Tell them everything about the weekend
choices.consequence: “Tell them everything about the weekend” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Marriage.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Quiet.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You stay her best friend. You attend the wedding. The marriage, predictably, does not last. She moves to your city when it ends. You walk her dog the first month.
You let the friendship dim. You realize, slowly, that some friendships don't survive twenties' damage. Your spouse, and the small life you built, becomes the center.

You tell her, fully, what happened in college. The friendship survives, barely, then heals. The wedding is, in the end, not what it would have been. You realize, late, that you protected her by being honest.
